activity.notes: Hasanuddin was the sixteenth ruler of Gowa and the last independent ruler before Gowa's subjugation in the Makassar War. Scholarly regnal lists place his reign in 1653–1669; exact abdication dates vary across modern renderings, so ATLAS preserves year granularity.

sources.title: A Chain of Kings: The Makassarese Chronicles of Gowa and Talloq
sources.citation_text: The scholarly reign list gives Sultan Hasanuddin as ruler of Gowa from 1653 to 1669.

sources.title: Tentang Gowa — Pemerintah Kabupaten Gowa
sources.citation_text: The official Gowa government history identifies Sultan Hasanuddin as the sixteenth ruler of Gowa and describes his leadership during the conflict with the VOC.
